verdict.rationale: Glama offers a no-login browser Inspector for testing MCP servers (glama-docs-24, glama-docs-1), suggesting free prototyping is possible, but community reports show that actually deploying/rebuilding an MCP server's quality score silently required adding a credit card—an undocumented paid gate that blocked iteration for days (glama-comm-2, glama-comm-3), directly contradicting the idea of a meaningful free tier for hosting/testing tool connections. missing for 10: documented free-tier limits on hosting/gateway usage, confirmation that deployment/build steps work without payment, and independent corroboration that the free tier suffices for real prototyping.
